meta.title: Zainab Kabira — Product Designer in Vancouver, Canada
meta.description: Independent product designer in Vancouver, Canada — a designer who builds. Shipped work with Google's Flutter team at Google I/O 2026 and MWC Barcelona.

introParagraphs: Six years across architecture and product design, designing what’s next – from India’s first carbon-positive modular home to shipping AI experiences with gskinner, brought to the world at Google I/O ’26 and MWC Barcelona ’25.
I believe every great design forms the basis for an even greater story and I’m here to keep writing mine.

items.quote: Zainab is a detailed and analytical designer with a true eagerness to learn and discover new opportunities. Her core strengths lie in her exceptional technical skills and ability to embrace new technologies for building great products. Zainab is a proactive and reliable collaborator who excels at communicating with developers, stakeholders, and her fellow designers. Zainab has been a fantastic member of our team, and I am certain she has a bright future ahead as she continues her professional journey.
items.author: Jared Bell

items.quote: Zainab is a very good designer to work with on daily basis. She has a deep care for human-centered design, which makes her design easier for end users to understand. While working with us she made sure, she took care of complex interactions and state management, which helped us to scale the projects very well.
items.author: Roopam Mishra

items.quote: Her work truly speaks for itself: it’s research backed, resilient against edge cases, and built with a beautiful aesthetic that is delightful to interact with. Zainab’s confidence and attention to detail make even the most complex challenges feel manageable. Whether vibe-coding or constructing 3D environments, she’s natural at tackling new tools and concepts with total fearlessness – an asset to any team!
items.author: Anna Groat

intro.heading: I trained as an architect. Now I design products people actually want to use.
body: With 6+ years spanning architecture and product design, I bring something most designers don’t: a structural way of thinking. I’ve spent 4+ years crafting zero-to-one products, scaling design systems, and designing AI-powered experiences – most recently for a genUI powered app showcased at Google I/O 2026.
From founder-led startups to globally recognised brands in sports, tech, and entertainment, I bring rigour, range, and an eye for detail to every build.

experience.overview: Product designer and design lead across AI, sports-tech, and consumer products for clients including Google and the PGA Tour. Work spanned end-to-end product design, design systems, and shipped engineering contributions.
bullets: Design co-lead for a generative-UI app featured on-stage at Google I/O and Cloud Next 2026. Built the design system from scratch and defined the interaction model for a net-new product category.
Led the UI redesign of a Flutter + Gemini showcase app presented at Mobile World Congress 2025, translating cutting-edge AI capabilities into a polished, demo-ready experience.

Designed and shipped 10+ major features for Existence, an AI time-tracking app, contributing to the design system, writing production code alongside the engineering team, and running QA and PR reviews.
Designed multiple apps within ShotLink 2.0 for the PGA Tour, the system used to track and verify every shot across 35–40 live tournaments annually on the global tour.

experience.overview: UX design and design system contributor.
bullets: Contributed to the feature redesign of aDintelle, an end-to-end agency operations platform trusted by 1000+ advertising agencies across media, digital, and creative sectors.
Contributed to the design system by establishing interaction state management patterns that helped the team scale design more efficiently across the product.

experience.overview: Interior architecture and residential project lead.
bullets: Designed interiors for multiple residential projects, bringing strong attention to detail and commitment to quality execution across every deliverable.

experience.overview: Architectural project lead across commercial and residential developments.
bullets: Designed and presented residential and commercial projects spanning office and apartment interiors.
Led coordination across 10 cross-functional trades to deliver a 2BHK home renovation within budget and timeline.

hatcha.title: Hatcha
intro: Earlier this year, the Flutter team released GenUI: an SDK that enables AI to compose UIs based on your design system at runtime.

To help Google present it at Google I/O and Google Cloud Next, gskinner was challenged to conceptualize, design, and build Hatcha: an open-source event-planning app where a host plans an event through a conversational interview with AI, and GenUI generates dynamic, themed, and interactive invites. I co-led the design, and ended up rethinking what it means to be a designer.

closing.heading: What designing for GenUI actually changed
closing.paragraph: The work didn’t disappear. It moved. From drawing every screen to curating a system the AI composes from. From mapping flows to mapping goals. From predicting every scenario to defining the rules of every scenario.

intro: Telecom apps are famously cluttered and frustrating. Fireflut demonstrated how Google Gemini can understand plans, usage patterns, and real-time network conditions to offer proactive solutions directly to consumers on the MWC 2025 stage in Barcelona.

closing.heading: Designing conversational telecommunications
closing.paragraph: Replacing complex multi-page account portals with intelligent natural language interactions that predict what users need.
